meta.name: scienceworld-container-relocator
meta.description: Moves an object from inventory to a specified container in a target room. Use when the task requires placing an item into a particular receptacle (e.g., 'move it to the orange box').

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将物品从背包移动到指定容器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在游戏或模拟环境中移动物品到特定容器
copy.tagline_en: Move an item from inventory to a specified container
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to move items to specific containers in a game or simulation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动将你背包中的物品移动到指定房间的容器里，包括先传送过去、移动物品，然后检查物品是否在容器内。
howto.when: 当你要求把背包中的物品放到另一房间的某个容器里时触发，比如说“把它放到橙色盒子里”。

say.text: 把这个蛋放到工作间的橙色盒子里。
say.note: Claude会自动传送并放置物品。

say.text: 将背包里的试管移到实验室的玻璃烧杯中。
say.note: 物品不在背包会先提示你。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically move an object from your inventory to a specified container in a target room, including teleporting to the room, moving the object, then verifying the placement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to move an inventory item into a specific container in another room, e.g., 'move it to the orange box'.

say_en.text: Put this egg into the orange box in the workshop.
say_en.note: Claude will teleport and place it.

say_en.text: Move the test tube from my inventory to the glass beaker in the lab.
say_en.note: If not in inventory, Claude will prompt.
